name: EKOVEST
recent: Ekovest 正在推进一项可放弃供股计划，以每股 RM0.20 发行最多 1,779,246,481 股新股；该计划已在 2026 年 10 月 30 日的特别股东大会上获股东通过。供股除权日为 2026 年 11 月 16 日，登记日为 2026 年 11 月 17 日，供股股份将于 2026 年 11 月 18 日开始交易。公司最近一期季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）录得净亏损。
notable: 779,246,481 股新股，每股 RM0.20，比例 3 供 5，已获股东在特别股东大会通过。
供股除权日为 2026 年 11 月 16 日，登记日为 2026 年 11 月 17 日。
供股股份将于 2026 年 11 月 18 日开始交易。
risks: 供股将以每股 RM0.20 发行最多 1,779,246,481 股新股，可能摊薄现有股东持股比例。
公司最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）录得净亏损 94,489,000 令吉。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 168,010,000 令吉，环比增长 15.2%，但同比下跌 16.6%；净亏损为 94,489,000 令吉，净亏损率为 56.2%，较上一季度的 51.8% 扩大。

recent_en: Ekovest is undertaking a renounceable rights issue of up to 1,779,246,481 new shares at RM0.20 each on the basis of 3 rights shares for every 5 existing shares, which was approved by shareholders at an EGM on 30 October 2026. The ex-date is 16 November 2026, entitlement date 17 November 2026, and the rights shares commence trading on 18 November 2026. The company reported a net loss in its latest quarter ended 30 June 2026.
notable_en: Proposed rights issue of up to 1,779,246,481 new shares at RM0.20 each on a 3-for-5 basis, approved by shareholders at an EGM.
Ex-date for the rights issue is 16 November 2026 and entitlement date is 17 November 2026.
The rights shares will commence trading on 18 November 2026.
risks_en: The rights issue of up to 1,779,246,481 new shares at RM0.20 each may dilute existing shareholders' stakes.
The company recorded a net loss of RM94,489,000 in the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM168,010,000, up 15.2% QoQ but down 16.6% YoY; net loss was RM94,489,000 with a net margin of -56.2%, wider than the previous quarter's -51.8%.
